_comment: Defect declarations for the support replay clip (demos/support_demo.json); see demos/README.md, Sidecar declarations. Uid 9's facing_flutter exemption (#1854) is gone: uid 9 passes on every one of seeds 0 to 4 since #1880 (ea0a9029: dense 2-tick FULL dumps, every exemption removed, Windows, 2026-10-31; 9f9bddee read 4.00, 4.00, 4.00, 4.00, 4.00, against 3; ea0a9029 reads 2 on every seed), so it is no longer exempted. The sim of every later #1880 commit is hash-identical to ea0a9029's at the 60 Hz body step on the seed-0 catalog.

overlap.reason: Team 1's Infantry (uid 6) reaches melee contact at the end of the clip (its count drops 120 -> 117 by tick 780) and compresses into the press: CI website demo-diff on PR #1677 measured a minimum neighbour distance of 1.318 wu against the 2.25 wu floor, merge-base 6.89, where contact came earlier and the sampled ticks missed it. Press-adjacent compression at contact, not standing interpenetration. Uid 9, overlap: Dense 2-tick FULL dumps, every exemption removed, Windows, seeds 0 to 4: 9f9bddee reads pass, pass, pass, pass, pass; ea0a9029 (#1880) reads 0.56, 0.56, 0.56, 0.56, 0.56, against 5.0. Traced on the clip seed: the 80-horse cavalry squadron marches on an ATTACK out of contact and turns its heading about 60 degrees between ticks 500 and 510 (9f9bddee: between 470 and 480, on a trajectory that diverges at tick 138), after which its riders spread off their slots (farthest 80 wu at tick 660, against at most 50 on 9f9bddee). Walking back, riders 6 and 7, 17 and 57 wu off their slots, pass within 0.56 wu of each other at tick 710. None of its riders' arrival targets is blending more than 30 degrees apart at any tick of the clip, and with the blend's earlier direction lerp in place of the constant-rate turn the riders spread the same way (79 wu at tick 660) but no pair dips under the floor. Riders of a squadron crossing while it re-forms after a heading turn on its march, out of contact and with no new order (#1894). Measured 2026-10-31. The sim of every later #1880 commit is hash-identical to ea0a9029's at the 60 Hz body step on the seed-0 catalog.

shape_residual.reason: Team 1's cavalry squadron (uid 8, 9 ranks, 960 wu deep) now deploys with its front rank on its line and marches a long diagonal toward its target, so the deep block spends the clip mid-turn and its rear ranks trail its grid: the same deep-block mid-turn mechanism declared for uid 8 in cycle-charge.json (#1546). CI website demo-diff on PR #1677: worst 77.78 wu against the 30 wu floor, merge-base 3.199.
